limitations: Fictional participants and simulated provider/FHIR services; no real patient contact or live EHR/exchange connection.
The 1,000-trajectory/500-invalid-closure evaluation is deterministic software execution, not 1,500 live AI trajectories.
Live Groq model quality and adapted public conversation rubric estimates are separate run records, with actual partial/failed counts and unknown usage retained.
No clinical outcome improvement, human usability study, independent translation/clinical review, or medical production approval is claimed.
MedAgentBench cloud-processing rights/container/original scorer remain unverified; credentialed MIMIC is disabled; Synthea was not run.
